title: Diamond Framework: Reputation-Weighted Validator Selection via Verifiable Non-Transferable Reputation
description: Paper and repository for the Diamond Framework, v0.2.2, deposited as 10.5281/zenodo.23651484 (version 2 of concept 10.5281/zenodo.23268373). Includes: the paper source and PDF (43 pp, sha256 89e71837...), a 38-script verification suite with byte-identical reruns, a falsification log (22 entries), an Avalanche Fuji phase-2 deployment with on-chain wiring verified (phase 1 of 2026-10-19 remains on chain as history), an 11-file anchor root (sha256 abe9c5535eb1dd7e462b49f19b52b828a9cfe235ccbcd32819f5daa37fe56bf7), and an OpenTimestamps receipt over that root which was still pending when the version was sealed on 2026-10-25 (four pending attestations, zero Bitcoin confirmations at seal time). The receipt over the preceding root (ca836947...) did complete: that seal is attested in Bitcoin blocks 972956, 972959 and 973014, and it covers the same eleven files but for one corrected ratio in Section 9, which is why it is archived under verification/ots-history/ and not cited for this version. The even earlier receipt over root 5ff84501 is superseded and is not cited either. v0.2.2 is a text release: it removes the statements that v0.2.1 could only correct in an errata sheet. Section 6 now describes the validator-bound statement that M4d delivers (Poseidon leaf with the validator address as a public input); the verification cost is the measured cold path, 286,144 gas (781 gwei break-even, 31x margin at 25 gwei) instead of the ~206k composition with an inlined key; the collusion detector declares W as an external input (D-7) and the on-chain alert as a non-sanction; the financial floor is stated as a minimum admission cost, not a guarantee; and the README lists the five roles v1 trusts. Earlier releases: v0.2.1 corrected the ZK paper-code mismatch (measured V3/Groth16 circuit, 94,438 constraints; recursion deferred); v0.1.0 was the first deposit. Verification: the offline Foundry and Rust suites plus the 38-script evidence harness, 11/11 audit gate. The anchor root covers eleven files. On the Fuji testnet a Groth16 verifier built from the repository's committed development key is deployed and announced through the registry's two-day guardian rotation: it carries no ceremony, records no certified admission, and the ceremony-key verifier, the recursive option and Teleporter cross-subnet latency remain declared deferred. The repository code is MIT; the manuscript and the frozen PDF are CC BY 4.0.
